package.description: Close multiple Windows applications at once.

en-US.description: Close multiple Windows applications at once.
en-US.longDescription: Close All Windows lets you select and close multiple applications at once. It sends a standard close signal to the selected applications and exits immediately after completing the task, so it consumes no system resources when it is not running.
en-US.name: Close All Windows
